'''Luum Ava''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Nagi Prime]] in the [[Nagi system/Legends|Nagi system]]. Located in the satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] [[Firefist]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], it was a barren rock.<ref name="atlas" />
